plugin.name: medo
settings.glyph.label: Glyph
settings.glyph.description: Icon shown on the bar beside today's count.
settings.rollover_hour.label: Day rollover hour
settings.rollover_hour.description: Hour (0-23) when today ends. 4 keeps late-night work on the previous day.
settings.default_estimate.label: Default estimate
settings.default_estimate.description: Minutes a task is worth when it has no estimate of its own.
settings.streak_threshold.label: Streak threshold
settings.streak_threshold.description: Daily score (0-100) needed for a day to extend the streak.
settings.trash_days.label: Trash retention
settings.trash_days.description: Days a deleted task stays restorable before rollover purges it.
settings.export_dir.label: Report export folder
settings.export_dir.description: Where exported Markdown and JSON reports land. Empty uses your Documents folder.
settings.sounds_enabled.label: Sound cues
settings.sounds_enabled.description: A chime when a task completes, a jingle when the whole list is done, a thud on delete.
settings.mascot_enabled.label: Mascot artwork
settings.mascot_enabled.description: Show the Medo blob in the panel header and dashboard instead of the text face.
settings.notify_morning.label: Morning digest
settings.notify_morning.description: A toast at the morning time with today's plan and carry-overs.
settings.notify_evening.label: Evening triage nudge
settings.notify_evening.description: A toast at the evening time when tasks are still open.
settings.notify_due.label: Due alerts
settings.notify_due.description: Toast when a task reaches its due time.
settings.notify_lead.label: Lead reminders
settings.notify_lead.description: Toast shortly before a task is due.
settings.notify_weekly.label: Weekly report toast
settings.notify_weekly.description: Toast when the weekly report is ready.
settings.notify_monthly.label: Monthly report toast
settings.notify_monthly.description: Toast when the monthly report is ready.
settings.notify_atrisk.label: At-risk nudge
settings.notify_atrisk.description: One afternoon toast when the day has barely moved.
settings.morning_time.label: Morning time
settings.evening_time.label: Evening time
settings.atrisk_time.label: At-risk time
settings.weekly_day.label: Weekly report day
settings.weekly_day.description: Day the weekly report toast fires.
settings.weekly_time.label: Weekly report time
settings.monthly_time.label: Monthly report time
settings.monthly_time.description: HH:MM on the 1st for the monthly report.
settings.quiet_start.label: Quiet hours start
settings.quiet_start.description: Reminders are suppressed from this time; due alerts still fire.
settings.quiet_end.label: Quiet hours end
settings.lead_min.label: Default lead time
settings.lead_min.description: Minutes before a due task to remind when the task has no lead of its own.
settings.cap_enabled.label: Daily soft cap
settings.cap_enabled.description: Warn when today's list grows past the cap.
settings.daily_cap.label: Cap
settings.daily_cap.description: How many tasks today holds before adding one asks first.
